title: tc-speed-reader
description:
Speed reading, one word at a time in a fixed frame, with the recognition point on a guide mark, the speed, words at
a time, a scrubber and the time left.

description.description: A quiet line under the heading – the source or what the passage is

text.description: The passage: plain text; a blank line starts a new paragraph

wpm.description: Words a minute, 100–1000. Changed by the element unless a tc-wpm-change listener calls preventDefault()

chunk.description: Words shown at a time, 1–3. Changed by the element unless a tc-chunk-change listener calls preventDefault()

position.description: The first word on screen (0-based). Changed by the element unless a tc-position-change listener calls preventDefault()
